rows.label: Verdilac Blueprint
rows.note: 5.45% stage 4, 7.5% stage 5, plus a bonus-stage roll, rotation A only

conditions: Only Rotation A carries the Verdilac roll; B and C give none. The board cycles A/B/C every 150 minutes, so A is up 2.5 hours out of every 7.5.
Complete every stage's bonus objective for a third roll from the final-stage table.
Host migration after extraction can wipe a completed bounty's reward; leave the landscape cleanly once the drop is confirmed.
bonuses: Run whichever hub is faster for you; Cetus and Fortuna share one drop table.
Farm Caliban, Korumm and Nepheri at the same time; their parts and the Archon set mods share these same bounties and all need Narmer Isoplast.

disclosures.title: no pity system
disclosures.body: About 5 full Rotation-A bounties clears it on average from the roughly 20% combined chance across stage 4, stage 5 and the bonus roll, with bad luck running well past that.
